newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint closes a shade firmer vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint closes a shade firmer vs dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed Friday trading a shade firmer against the dollar after trading in a narrow range, dealers said.
The forint closed at 188.15/20 to the dollar compared with an opening of 188.20/25 and was right on the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level.
The Hungarian unit followed the slow dollar/mark movements all day, dealers added.
"The U.S. markets are closed today, so there was very little movement," said Attila Behan of ING Bank.
